channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Indian Rupee attracts bids as traders trim Fed interest rate hike bets
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) gains ground against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday after rising significantly in the last three trading days.

item.title: Euro edges higher against British Pound as oil surge lifts ECB rate expectations
item.description: The EUR/GBP cross gains momentum to near 0.8535 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. Traders ramp up bets on the Bank of England (BoE) and European Central Bank (ECB) rate hikes as oil price surge reignites inflation fears.

item.title: ECB's Kocher: Ready to take monetary policy action at any time if needed
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council member Martin Kocher said on Wednesday that the central bank prepared to implement monetary policy measures whenever necessary.

item.title: Gold remains depressed as bears shrug off weaker USD amid Fed hike bets
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) sticks to modest intraday losses through the Asian session on Wednesday, though it lacks follow-through and holds above the $4,000 psychological mark.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Consolidates around $79.00, above 200-day EMA and 23.6% Fibo.
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – oscillates in a narrow band during the Asian session on Wednesday, consolidating its weekly gains to a nearly one-month peak set the previous day.

item.title: British Pound advances as US Dollar remains subdued following inflation data
item.description: GBP/USD rises for the second consecutive day, trading around 1.3400 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Wednesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Bulls remain cautious below 23.6% Fibo. and 1.1470 hurdle
item.description: The EUR/USD pair attracts some dip-buyers following the previous day's pullback from the 1.1460-1.1470 horizontal resistance, though it remains confined within a multi-week-old range.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Gains traction above 113.00, bullish trend stays firm above 100-day SMA
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross trades in positive territory around 113.25 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) edges lower against the Australian Dollar (AUD) after reports regarding the Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF).

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah firms after S&P Global reaffirms stable grade rating
item.description: USD/IDR loses ground for the second consecutive day, trading around 18,110 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair depreciates as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) strengthens following S&P Global Ratings' reaffirmation of Indonesia’s investment-grade credit rating with a stable outlook.

item.title: United States Dollar Index stays below 101 as traders trim hawkish Fed bets
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) underperforms its major currency peers as traders have trimmed Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate hike expectations for the current year, following the release of the softer-than-expected United States (US) Consumer Price Index (CPI) data for June.

item.title: Swiss Franc steadies as US Dollar declines following softer inflation data
item.description: USD/CHF steadies after registering 0.7% losses in the previous day, trading around 0.8090 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: China’s NBS: The economy remains resilient despite Q2 slowdown
item.description: China’s Deputy Head of the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) expresses confidence during the Asian market session on Wednesday that the economy remains resilient despite a slowdown in the second quarter this year.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Remains near the symmetrical triangle top around 185.50
item.description: EUR/JPY extends its gains for the third successive day, trading around 185.40 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency cross is retaining a mildly bullish tone as it holds above both the nine-period and 50-period Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs).

item.title: US CENTCOM says it ends latest round of strikes targeting Iran
item.description: The United States (US) military's Central Command (CENTCOM) confirms that it conducted another set of strikes against Iran at 10 PM ET on July 14.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar remains firm above 0.5800 despite weak China GDP data
item.description: The NZD/USD pair trades in positive territory around 0.5825 during the Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) remains firm against the US Dollar (USD) after the Chinese economic data.

item.title: Australian Dollar remains stronger following China’s economic data
item.description: AUD/USD extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around 0.6980 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair holds gains as the Australian Dollar (AUD) remains stronger following the release of key economic data from China, Australia’s close trading partner.

item.title: Iran’s IRGC: Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until the 'end of America’s evils'
item.description: The Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) said on Wednesday that the “Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until the 'end of America’s evils.”

item.title: Breaking: China’s economy expands 4.3% YoY in Q2, vs. 4.5% expected
item.description: China’s economy expanded 4.3% YoY in the second quarter (Q2) of 2026, compared to a 5.0% growth in Q1, the official data published by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) showed on Wednesday. The figure came in below the market consensus of 4.5%.

item.title: Canadian Dollar climbs to four-week top vs USD amid rising Oil prices; focus shifts to BoC
item.description: The USD/CAD pair remains under some selling pressure for the second straight day and drops to a four-week low, around the 1.4045-1.4040 region during the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD hovers near $58.50 amid market caution
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) inches lower after registering gains in the previous day, trading around $58.50 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: British Pound gains traction above 1.3400 as softer US CPI dampens Fed rate hike expectations
item.description: The GBP/USD pair gains ground to near 1.3405 during the early Asian session on Wednesday. The US dollar (USD) weakens against the British Pound (GBP) as softer-than-expected US inflation in June tempered expectations for US Federal Reserve (Fed) policy tightening.

item.title: Japanese Yen edges higher vs weaker USD; bulls seem hesitant amid Iran risks
item.description: The USD/JPY pair struggles to capitalize on the previous day's late rebound from the vicinity of mid-161.00s, or the weekly low, and trades with a mild negative bias for the second straight day on Wednesday.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7910 vs. 6.7990 previous
item.description: On Wednesday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7910 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7990 and 6.7695 Reuters estimate.

item.title: WTI rises as Trump threatens strikes on Iran
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price extends its gains for the third successive day, trading around $79.20 per barrel during the Asian hours on Wednesday. Crude oil prices have climbed following threats from US President Donald Trump regarding additional military strikes on Iran.

item.title: Euro gathers strength above 1.1400 after soft US inflation data
item.description: The EUR/USD pair gains ground to near 1.1425 during the early Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The US Dollar (USD) weakens against the Euro (EUR) as softer-than-expected US inflation data temporarily eased pressure on the Federal Reserve (Fed).

item.title: US President Donald Trump says US pressed Iran to reach agreement
item.description: US President Donald Trump said that Iran retains some resilience but is largely depleted. He emphasized that he will preserve energy objectives in Iran until the end, Fox News reported on Tuesday.

item.title: Gold climbs to near $4,050 on softer US CPI
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) rises to around $4,050 during the early Asian session on Wednesday. The precious metal rebounds as softer-than-expected US inflation data boosted hopes of the US Federal ‌Reserve (Fed) adopting a less hawkish stance.

item.title: Chinese Yuan: Europe questions undervaluation and trade gap – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank's Michael Every reports that Chancellor Merz has called for dialogue with China on monetary and FX policy, arguing CNY is 20–30% undervalued and should float more freely.

item.title: China: Fiscal support set to re-accelerate – Standard Chartered
item.description: Standard Chartered economists Carol Liao and Hunter Chan note that China’s fiscal support softened in Q2 2026 after strong Q1 activity, leading to a sharp slowdown in infrastructure FAI similar to H2-2025.
